entries.source: Monumenta Boica. 40 \= Collectio nova 13, Monumenta Episcopatus Wirziburgensis
entries.german: (...) Vnd vmb daz alle diese virbuntnisse stücke vnd artikeln als sie hie vor vnd nah geschriebin stent von vns iewedersijt veste vnd stede vnd gantze liebe, vnd fruntschaf vnder vns vnd den vnsern virliben, vnd alle vsſflouſe vnd geschiechte vnd zweiunge die geschen vnd vsſstan mochten virhalten vnd hiengeleget werden, so han wir den strengen ritter Ebirharten von Rosenberg vnsern vogd zü Durne odir wer zü den ziten vnser amptman zü Durne were vür vns, vnd der vorgenante herre von Wirtzeburg Conraden Jemerer ritter sinen amptman zü Hohenburg odir wer zü zijten al da zü Hohenburg amptman ist vur sich zü ratluten, vnd wir bede mit einander den edeln man Rodolph grauen von Wertheim zü eime gemeinen obirmanne gekorn, also welchem vnder vns oder den vnsern die wir bede zü virantwortene hetten kein obirgrif odir schade gesche, der mag vnd sal daz zü hant an bede die vorgenanten vnser ratlute brengen, vnd sollent die selben ratlute binnen achtagen dar nah die clage an sie bracht wirt zü Wertheim in die stad riden, vnd nummer danne kommen (...)
entries.english: (...) And so that all these binding pieces and articles, as they are written here before and after, may be firmly and steadily observed by each of us with complete affection and friendship among us and our beloved ones, and that all disputes and events and disagreements that have occurred or may occur may be prevented and settled, we have appointed the strict knight Eberhard von Rosenberg, our bailiff in Durne, or whoever may be our official in Durne at the time, to be our counselor, and the aforesaid lord from Würzburg, Knight Conrad Jemerer, his official in Hohenburg, or whoever may be the official in Hohenburg at the time, to be his counselor, and we both, together with the noble man Rodolph, count of Wertheim, have chosen a common arbiter, so that to him, or to our people whom we both had to answer for, no offense or harm may occur; he may and shall immediately bring the matter before both of our aforesaid counselors, and the same counselors shall, within eight days thereafter, ride to the city of Wertheim when a complaint is brought before them, and shall never come (...)
